messages:
Mira: Hey team — thinking of a casual rooftop happy hour this Friday at 6pm? Mini-golf pop-up on the terrace + shuffleboard. Bring a small snack or mocktail to share. Thoughts? :sunset:

Kevin: Love it. I'm in. Can we do 5:30 start for folks coming straight from meetings?

Ana: Count me in. I can bring veggie sliders (2 dozen). Any allergies?

Jordan: I'll DJ if someone brings a speaker. Also can bring folding stools.

Leo: Weather call? If it rains should we move to Ground Floor lounge?

Mira: good call — if rain we'll DM everyone and move inside. I'll make a calendar invite and reserve the terrace.

Sam: RSVP +1 (friend visiting). Also can grab a 6-pack of non-alc seltzers.

Sasha: I'm gluten-free — will there be gf options? otherwise I can bring GF brownies.

Kevin: I'll pick up a Bluetooth speaker from conference room A.

ops-bot: reminder: Please don't bring open flames or candles to the terrace. See building policy: https://intranet/amenities/roof-top

Mira: Quick poll — do we want it Friday (this week) or next Thursday? React :one: for Fri, :two: for Thu

Jordan: :one:

Ana: :one:

Leo: :two: (can't do Fri after 6:15)

Sam: :one:

Sasha: :two: (earlier meeting Fri)

Mira: OK looks like mixed — leaning Fri this week. I'll DM people who voted two to check times. Calendar invite up in 10.

Kevin: Also: anyone want to carpool? I have room for 2 on my bike rack for scooters.

Mira: Awesome. Seating note — bring light layers. See you all! :raised_hands:
